GEO-REPLICATION ALONE              FAILOVER GROUP
Replicates data:      yes           Replicates data: yes (underneath)
Manages the endpoint: NO            Manages the endpoint: YES
  (client must know server name)      (one stable DNS name, always)
Automatic failover:   no            Automatic failover: optional, policy-based
caption: The app connects to one name; Azure decides which region that name means.

steps.label: Manual Policy
steps.sub: A DBA runs the failover explicitly — same as geo-replication

steps.label: Automatic Policy
steps.sub: Fails over on its own after a configurable grace period

code:
New-AzSqlDatabaseFailoverGroup `
  -ServerName "contoso-sql-east" `
  -FailoverGroupName "contoso-fg" `
  -PartnerServerName "contoso-sql-west" `
  -FailoverPolicy Automatic `
  -GracePeriodWithDataLossHours 1

# App connects to: contoso-fg.database.windows.net
caption: A server-level Azure resource — no CREATE FAILOVER GROUP in T-SQL.

subtitle: An older mechanism, still real, still used in hybrid scenarios.
